samples.summary: Todo checklist left entirely unchecked despite the paired lessons.md and the codebase showing the feature already implemented.
samples.evidence: All five acceptance-criteria boxes (lines 11-19, e.g. 'The image viewer's top bar shows a back button that returns to the documents list.') remain '[ ]' unchecked, yet use-documents-path.ts, the SiteHeader `leading` slot, ImageViewer's `onClose`/Escape handling, and docs/design/image-viewer.md's 'Leaving the viewer (issue #840)' section all already exist in the tree matching this plan. A reader skimming just this file would think none of the work has landed.
